# Seed Order 2027

To order in January from Wildacre Seeds, who ship in paper packets.

- San Marzano tomatoes, for sauce, as planned in the [[Garden Log]]
- Borlotti beans and Painted Mountain corn for a Three Sisters bed
- Crown Prince squash
- Calendula to pull in pollinators

Skip courgettes. Tom always has more than he can give away.
